name: @pipeworx/mcp-customer-io

tools.name: cio_list_campaigns
tools.description: Return Customer.io lifecycle campaigns with IDs, names, state, trigger configuration, actions, tags, and timestamps. Answers which automations exist and whether they are running, drafted, or stopped.

tools.name: cio_campaign_metrics
tools.description: Return time-bucketed Customer.io delivery, bounce, open, click, unsubscribe, and conversion metrics for one campaign. Answers how a lifecycle campaign performed and when engagement changed.

tools.name: cio_list_segments
tools.description: Return Customer.io audience segments with IDs, names, descriptions, dynamic or manual type, build progress, tags, and timestamps. Answers which audiences are available for targeting or analysis.

tools.name: cio_list_messages
tools.description: Return a bounded page of Customer.io message deliveries with recipients, channel, campaign or newsletter parent, and delivery engagement timestamps. Answers which messages reached, bounced, opened, clicked, converted, or unsubscribed recipients.

start.description: Cursor from the previous response next field

start_ts.description: Delivery creation range start as Unix seconds

end_ts.description: Delivery creation range end as Unix seconds

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-customer-io forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the customer-io pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
